answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a unique-identity stake: before an agent may sign an attestation with its quill, it must lock a bond that is slashed if that same key ever signs for two different identities. Honest workers in the shared garden post one reusable bond and keep their standing; an attacker who floods the orchard with a thousand fake personas must instead lock a thousand separate bonds up front, so the price of the attack grows linearly with each forged agent and is forfeited the moment the link is detected.
